explication: Rill is an agent-first BI product: users define data models and metrics, explore dashboards or ask questions, and can deploy projects to Rill Cloud. The principal workflow runs from project files through parsing and resource reconciliation, connectors and OLAP execution, then query APIs to dashboards or agents. Separate branches cover the CLI/local developer experience and cloud administration, deployment, billing, alerts, and reports. README statements establish several product capabilities; source excerpts and the SOURCE INDEX support only the implementation links shown, so uncertain internal connections are omitted or marked unverified.
